clock: UTC daily synthetic bars; not an exchange calendar
teaching_contract: Four 120-row scenarios × three parameter presets. Component traces, statuses, reasons, and classifications are author-derived.

scenarios.label: Canonical · four regimes
scenarios.description: Rising, falling, quiet, and renewed-trend segments with deterministic shocks.

scenarios.label: Comparison · persistent rise
scenarios.description: A persistent positive path shows saturation and smoothing lag without claiming a forecast.

scenarios.label: Comparison · range cycle
scenarios.description: A bounded oscillating path exposes repeated range relocation and threshold crossings.

scenarios.label: Boundary · flat then shock
scenarios.description: A long zero-movement prefix exposes neutral or undefined denominators before a controlled shock.
